tasks.gr8-forces-motion-and-measurement-t4: Topic: Forces, motion and measurement. Cover speed, distance, time, simple motion calculations, friction, gravitational force, magnetic force, and electrostatic force. Ask Grade 8 learners to calculate speed, identify force types in scenarios, and reason about how forces affect movement.
tasks.gr8-forms-and-transfer-of-energy-t4: Topic: Forms and transfer of energy. Cover heat, light, sound, chemical, electrical, and mechanical energy, plus conduction, convection, radiation, and conservation of energy. Ask Grade 8 learners to trace energy transfers, compare heat-transfer pathways, and explain everyday energy systems.
